messages:
sam: FYI noticed a spike in decode errors for quant-v4b in ap-southeast during the night window. Error rate ~4% on the canary. Thinking a region-scoped runtime pin while we triage. :thinking:

maya: Can we avoid a global runtime freeze? region-only pin seems fine. If we pin, we should add a routing fallback for critical tenants.

lisa: Heads up: SDK 2.7 clients show slightly different KV cache marshaling which is likely contributing. We have a compatibility shim in SDK 2.8.1 ready to publish. Suggest holding unpin until SDK patch is out and buyers have been notified.

zach: Oncall: correlating metrics show increased memory churn + GC pauses on long-seq requests -> higher latency and occasional decode failures. Rerouting some traffic is a good short-term mitigation. Rolling back a runtime is less risky than reverting model.

sam: Proposed steps: 1) apply runtime pin scoped to ap-southeast for quantized model group; 2) route 25% traffic to qn-v4b-lite; 3) block auto-unpin until SDK 2.8.1 publish + 2 canary cycles. I'll trigger the pin now.

deploybot: Automated: pin applied -> scope=runtime:v3.2, model_group=quantized, region=ap-southeast, id=pin-1729345678, started=2026-03-23T03:14Z. Auto-unpin disabled while advisory open.

maya: I've updated the rollout doc and added a canary watch (latency, decode errors, GC). Also added a tenant list for priority reroutes.

oncall-bot: Alert: decode_error_rate 4.1% -> triggered. Monitoring window extended to 20m.

lisa: SDK 2.8.1 published to pypi/npm. Release includes KV cache marshaling shim + migration patch. Will draft a short advisory for release notes.

zach: Holding traffic config for 45m. If errors drop <1.5% for 20m across canary we'll re-evaluate unpin. Otherwise escalate to rollback.

eng-platform: Release notes entry added: "Regional runtime pin (ap-southeast) for runtime v3.2 affecting quantized models due to KVCACHE regression when interacting with SDK 2.7. Action: upgrade to SDK 2.8.1+; temporary routing to qn-v4b-lite applied for mitigations."

sam: Leaving pin in place until we see two consecutive healthy canary cycles post SDK adoption or until 03:30Z if issues persist. I'll post status updates. :white_check_mark:
